name: cancore_connect_wallet
description: Ask the Cancore wallet owner to authorize this server. Opens the consent page in their browser and waits; on approval the server keeps a scoped grant (queue a request, read the queue — never sign) and no token is returned to you. Call it when a cancore_* tool says there is no access, and call it again while it answers pending.

appName.description: how to introduce yourself on the consent page (display only)

force.description: ask again even if this stand is already authorized

waitSeconds.description: how long to wait for the owner in this call, 5–300 (default 45); the request stays live either way

name: cancore_intent_status
description: Outcome of a queued request: pending (waiting for the user), executed (signed and committed) or rejected.

name: cancore_list_intents
description: Requests still awaiting the wallet owner's decision.

name: cancore_propose_autotrade
description: Ask the Cancore wallet owner to approve an auto-trade — buying one token for another straight from the Cancore pool, with no counterparty to wait for. Queues a request and returns its id; it does NOT trade and never returns anything to sign. Name the pair by token symbol and do NOT invent a rate: the wallet prices it live and shows the owner what the trade would buy before they approve it. Poll cancore_intent_status for the outcome.

agentLabel.description: how to identify yourself to the user (display only)

name: cancore_propose_order
description: Ask the Cancore wallet owner to approve a cross-chain order (swap offer). Queues a request and returns its id — it does NOT place the order and never returns anything to sign. The user reviews it in their own create-order form and places it themselves; poll cancore_intent_status for the outcome.

agentLabel.description: how to identify yourself to the user (display only)

sourceNetwork.description: network the maker pays from, e.g. "canton" or "sepolia"

sourceTokenAddress.description: instrument id (Canton) or contract address (EVM/Tron) being offered

sourceTokenName.description: display name for the offered token, when the wallet's token list may not carry it

targetNetwork.description: network the maker wants to receive on

targetTokenAddress.description: instrument id or contract address wanted in return

targetTokenName.description: display name for the wanted token

name: cancore_propose_transfer
description: Ask the Cancore wallet owner to approve a transfer. Queues a request and returns its id — it does NOT send funds and never returns anything to sign. The user reviews it in their wallet and signs with their own key; poll cancore_intent_status for the outcome.

agentLabel.description: how to identify yourself to the user (display only)

description.description: memo shown to the user, and carried with the transfer

receiverPartyId.description: Canton party id of the recipient ("hint::namespace")

tokenId.description: instrument to send; defaults to the wallet's CC
